set.body: Turn JVM TransformDescriptor metadata into executable affine or nonlinear coordinate maps by loading ANTs, FSL, and AFNI transform assets behind JVM adapters. Normalize tool-specific coordinate, orientation, units, and transform-direction conventions at the boundary. Acceptance: descriptors resolve to typed morphisms with lossless provenance; exact, provided, approximate, and missing inverse quality remain distinct; malformed or convention-incompatible assets fail explicitly; fixture-backed JVM tests cover at least one affine and one displacement path and compare world-coordinate results to an independent oracle.
set.title: Spatial transform ingestion: execute ANTs, FSL, and AFNI assets
